record.name: Vercel
record.one_liner: Frontend cloud platform for deploying and scaling web applications and serverless functions.
record.access_note: Developers can sign up for a free hobby plan and generate personal access tokens directly in their account settings.
record.api_note: The REST API covers deployments, projects, domains, DNS, certs, billing, and infrastructure configuration.

evidence.quote: Vercel Access Tokens are required to authenticate and use the Vercel API. Include the token in the Authorization header
You create and manage them on the Account Tokens page, under the Settings area of your account
All endpoints live under the URL and follow the REST architecture.
Vercel MCP is Vercel's official MCP server.
